thresholds.metric: success (accept match in SYMBOLS, word-boundary) + median paired total_cost_usd delta
thresholds.green: success_delta >= +15pp AND median paired cost delta <= +20% AND adoption >= 70%
thresholds.yellow: success_delta >= +8pp; OR success parity (>= -3pp) with savings >= 20%
